reading.body:
This facility's power capacity is not published. Barclays acquired two New Jersey data centers as part of its 2008 purchase of Lehman Brothers North American operations, and this Union County site is one of those two facilities, but the operator has not disclosed electrical specifications for either location.

Without a published power figure, the campus cannot be ranked against New Jersey's 111.3 megawatts of disclosed capacity across five facilities with published specs. The state has 48 mapped data centers overall, the vast majority of which disclose no capacity data to the public.

Barclays' corporate website and public sources do not name a specific street address or power rating for this facility. Any assessment of its significance to AI infrastructure depends on information the operator has not released.
